item.title: DMZ key and locations in Modern Warfare 4
item.description: There are loads of DMZ keys in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 . Used to open both locked containers and locked doors, keys are your fast-track to getting your hands on some of the best loot the extraction mode has to offer. However, when you receive a key, you're only given a brief description of where to use it, so we're going to outline where you can use every key the game has to offer.

item.title: Nintendo Officially Shuts Down Switch 2 Jailbreak in New Update
item.description: Console manufacturers and hackers have a fun game they like to play. Hackers will find a way to jailbreak a system , and the console maker will push an update that renders that jailbreak inept. The two parties go back and forth in this cycle. This is the game Nintendo is currently stuck in, and its most recent firmware update seeks to end a popular Switch 2 jailbreak.

item.title: How to get and use the Song of Storms in Ocarina of Time
item.description: The Song of Storms is one of the iconic melodies from The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake, and you can unlock it shortly after you become adult Link. The song itself has a few uses in the world, but you will need it to progress in the story, particularly for the Bottom of the Well dungeon. Getting it also means you can access some passageways to get rupees and other useful items.

item.title: Universes Beyond’s Most Intense Villain Officially Joins Magic: The Gathering’s Top 10 Commanders
item.description: Fire Lord Azula has firebent her way into the top 10 most popular Magic: The Gathering commanders, knocking two longtime favorites down the rankings in the process. According to EDHREC , the Avatar: The Last Airbender villain is now the format's 10th most-built commander, overtaking the monocolored Angel typal commander Giada, Font of Hope and Naya (red, green, and white) Dinosaur powerhouse Pantlaza, Sun-Favored .

item.title: GTA 6 is Playable on Xbox One, Rockstar Officially Confirms
item.description: In a surprise late-stage twist, it looks like Grand Theft Auto 6 will be coming to the Xbox One after all. While the impending mega-hit was previously announced only for Xbox Series consoles and PlayStation 5, the game is also arriving on Xbox’s last-gen console.

item.title: Marathon’s Big PvE Update Is Starting to Look a Lot Like Destiny
item.description: Since Marathon was released this March, developer Bungie has spent the majority of the year updating and tweaking the extraction shooter to make it more welcoming to a wider audience. This is largely part of a push to evolve the game after the studio revealed it hadn't met initial expectations. Following the Nightfall refresh in October, the game is set to change even more with the upcoming Symbiosis update on Dec. 8. Bungie has just shared a ton of new details and some of the additions seem very familiar.

item.title: GTA 6 Officially Breaks Pre-order Records on PlayStation and Xbox Stores
item.description: Grand Theft Auto 6 has broken pre-order records on both the PlayStation and Xbox stores as it's already one of 2026's top-selling games.

item.title: Official GTA 6 Update Is Bad News For PC Players
item.description: In Early October, reports suggested that Rockstar parent company Take-Two worked out a deal for exclusive game streaming rights that could bring Grand Theft Auto 6 to PC platforms. At the time, Microsoft denied the rumors. A month later, Rockstar itself has squashed all hope that GTA 6 might be playable day one on PC platforms.

item.title: All Heart Containers and Pieces of Heart locations in Ocarina of Time
item.description: Heart Containers and Pieces of Heart give you more health in Ocarina of Time. Here's where to find all of them, so you can max out your health.
